/* Any JavaScript here will be loaded for all users on every page load. */ /* Skill cards ({{Skill|ID}}) and skill trees ({{Skilltree|...}}): clicking a version name (Basic, Flame ...), a chain icon or the rank item button (Fantasia of Sorcery) shows that card. Without this script the same switching is done by CSS (:target), but then only one card per page can be switched independently, the address of the page changes, and in a skill tree the open card closes when the pointer leaves it. With it, every card on the page keeps its own choice, the address does not change, the page does not scroll, the icon of a skill tree tile follows the card that is shown, and a skill tree card that was clicked open stays open. Paste at the end of MediaWiki:Common.js */ mw.hook( 'wikipage.content' ).add( function ( $content ) { $content.find( '.aa-skill-set' ).each( function () { var set = this; if ( set.getAttribute( 'data-aa-skill-js' ) ) { return; } set.setAttribute( 'data-aa-skill-js', '1' ); var tile = set.closest ? set.closest( '.aa-tree-tile' ) : null; function isSwitch( e ) { var link = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest( 'a[href*="#aa-skill"]' ) : null; return link && /v(\d+)k(\d+)$/.test( link.getAttribute( 'href' ) ) ? link : null; } // a click on a link would move the focus from the tile to the link, and the open card would close set.addEventListener( 'mousedown', function ( e ) { if ( tile && isSwitch( e ) ) { e.preventDefault(); } } ); set.addEventListener( 'click', function ( e ) { var link = isSwitch( e ); if ( !link ) { return; } var m = /v(\d+)k(\d+)$/.exec( link.getAttribute( 'href' ) ); var box = set.querySelector( ':scope > .aa-varset-v' + m[1] ); if ( !box ) { return; } e.preventDefault(); Array.prototype.forEach.call( set.querySelectorAll( ':scope > .aa-varset' ), function ( o ) { o.style.display = ( o === box ) ? 'grid' : 'none'; } ); Array.prototype.forEach.call( box.children, function ( card ) { card.style.visibility = card.classList.contains( 'aa-card-k' + m[2] ) ? 'visible' : 'hidden'; } ); // the icon of a skill tree tile var icons = set.querySelector( ':scope > .aa-tileicons' ); if ( icons ) { Array.prototype.forEach.call( icons.children, function ( ic ) { ic.style.display = ( ic.classList.contains( 'aa-ti-v' + m[1] ) && ic.classList.contains( 'aa-ti-k' + m[2] ) ) ? 'block' : 'none'; } ); } if ( tile ) { tile.focus( { preventScroll: true } ); } } ); } ); } ); /* Lazy skill cards. A skill link made by {{SkillLink|id|tree=...}}, {{TreeSkills}} or {{TreeCombo}} carries only its icon and name (class aa-lazy, data-sid, data-tree). The card is asked from the wiki (action=parse, {{#invoke:Skilltree|card|id|Tree}}) when the pointer first rests on the link, and the other links of the same group are fetched quietly after it, so the next hover is instant. An answer is cached in the browser and by the wiki for a day. The skill switching block (versions, chains) keeps working in the cards that arrive, because they are announced with mw.hook( 'wikipage.content' ). Paste at the end of MediaWiki:Common.js, after the block "Skill cards ... skill trees". */ ( function () { var cache = {}; // 'id|Tree' -> promise of the html of the card ('' when it failed) var queue = []; var running = 0; var counter = 0; function key( span ) { return span.getAttribute( 'data-sid' ) + '|' + span.getAttribute( 'data-tree' ); } function fetchCard( k ) { if ( cache[ k ] ) { return cache[ k ]; } var p = k.split( '|' ); cache[ k ] = mw.loader.using( 'mediawiki.api' ).then( function () { return new mw.Api().get( { action: 'parse', format: 'json', formatversion: 2, contentmodel: 'wikitext', title: mw.config.get( 'wgPageName' ), text: '{{#invoke:Skilltree|card|' + p[ 0 ] + '|' + p[ 1 ] + '}}', prop: 'text', disablelimitreport: 1, disableeditsection: 1, disabletoc: 1, wrapoutputclass: '', maxage: 86400, smaxage: 86400 } ); } ).then( function ( r ) { var tmp = document.createElement( 'div' ); tmp.innerHTML = r.parse.text; var card = tmp.querySelector( '.aa-lazy-card' ); if ( !card ) { throw new Error( 'no card' ); } return card.innerHTML; } ).catch( function () { delete cache[ k ]; // try again at the next hover return ''; } ); return cache[ k ]; } // the anchors of a card made on the server are the same for every card of that skill: give each card on the page its own function uniquify( root ) { var n = ++counter; function fix( s ) { return s.replace( /-(v\d+k\d+)$/, '-x' + n + '-$1' ); } Array.prototype.forEach.call( root.querySelectorAll( '[id^="aa-skill"]' ), function ( el ) { el.id = fix( el.id ); } ); Array.prototype.forEach.call( root.querySelectorAll( 'a[href^="#aa-skill"]' ), function ( a ) { a.setAttribute( 'href', fix( a.getAttribute( 'href' ) ) ); } ); } function fill( span ) { var state = span.getAttribute( 'data-aa-lazy' ); if ( state === 'loading' || state === 'done' ) { return; } span.setAttribute( 'data-aa-lazy', 'loading' ); fetchCard( key( span ) ).then( function ( html ) { var holder = span.querySelector( ':scope > .aa-skilltip-card' ); if ( !html || !holder ) { span.removeAttribute( 'data-aa-lazy' ); return; } holder.innerHTML = html; uniquify( holder ); span.setAttribute( 'data-aa-lazy', 'done' ); mw.hook( 'wikipage.content' ).fire( $( holder ) ); } ); prefetchGroup( span ); } // the links of the same list or card are fetched after the one that is hovered (two at a time) function prefetchGroup( span ) { var group = span.closest( '.aa-ts, .aa-tc' ); if ( !group ) { return; } Array.prototype.forEach.call( group.querySelectorAll( '.aa-lazy' ), function ( s ) { var k = key( s ); if ( !cache[ k ] && queue.indexOf( k ) === -1 ) { queue.push( k ); } } ); pump(); } function pump() { while ( running < 2 && queue.length ) { var k = queue.shift(); if ( cache[ k ] ) { continue; } running++; fetchCard( k ).then( function () { running--; pump(); } ); } } function onEnter( e ) { var span = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest( '.aa-lazy' ) : null; if ( span ) { fill( span ); } } document.addEventListener( 'mouseover', onEnter ); document.addEventListener( 'focusin', onEnter ); document.addEventListener( 'touchstart', onEnter, { passive: true } ); }() ); /* Edit page quick jump buttons (preview <-> editor), shown at the bottom of the Contents menu */ mw.loader.using('mediawiki.util').then(function () { var action = mw.config.get('wgAction'); if (action !== 'edit' && action !== 'submit') { return; } $(function () { if (!document.getElementById('wpTextbox1')) { return; } /* source editor only */ mw.util.addCSS( '.aa-jump{position:fixed;right:20px;bottom:20px;z-index:150;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}' + '.aa-jump.aa-jump-toc{position:static;flex-direction:row;padding:12px 16px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--border-color-base,#555)}' + '.aa-jump.aa-jump-toc button{flex:1}' + '.aa-jump button{cursor:pointer;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:8px;font:600 14px/1 inherit;' + 'color:var(--color-emphasized,#fff);background:var(--color-surface-2,#333);' + 'border:1px solid var(--border-color-base,#555);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}' + '.aa-jump button:hover{background:var(--color-surface-3,#444)}' + '#wikiPreview,#wikiEditor-ui-toolbar,#wpTextbox1{scroll-margin-top:72px}' ); var box = $('
'); var up = $('').on('click', function () { var p = document.getElementById('wikiPreview'); if (p) { p.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }); } }); var down = $('').on('click', function () { var t = document.getElementById('wikiEditor-ui-toolbar') || document.getElementById('wpTextbox1'); t.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }); document.getElementById('wpTextbox1').focus({ preventScroll: true }); }); box.append(up, down).appendTo(document.body); function sync() { var p = document.getElementById('wikiPreview'); up.toggle(!!p && p.offsetHeight > 0 && $.trim($(p).text()) !== ''); /* dock into the Contents card when it exists, otherwise float in the corner */ var toc = document.getElementById('mw-panel-toc'); if (toc) { if (box[0].parentNode !== toc) { box.addClass('aa-jump-toc').appendTo(toc); } } else if (box[0].parentNode !== document.body) { box.removeClass('aa-jump-toc').appendTo(document.body); } } sync(); setInterval(sync, 1000); /* also covers live preview and a rebuilt Contents menu */ }); }); /* Item, skill and buff hover cards: the hover card opens towards the middle of the loot table (so right of the tiles on the left half, left of the tiles on the right half). If the card would run out of the window on that side, it opens on the other side. On a phone the CSS opens it downwards. */ ( function () { function place( tile ) { var area = tile.closest( '.aa-loot' ) || tile.parentNode; var box = area.getBoundingClientRect(); var r = tile.getBoundingClientRect(); var tileMid = ( r.left + r.right ) / 2; var boxMid = ( box.left + box.right ) / 2; tile.classList.toggle( 'aa-loot-left', tileMid > boxMid + 8 ); // then check that the card is inside the window, and use the other side if it is not var card = tile.querySelector( '.aa-itemtip-card' ); if ( !card ) { return; } window.requestAnimationFrame( function () { var c = card.getBoundingClientRect(); if ( !c.width ) { return; } var vw = document.documentElement.clientWidth; if ( c.right > vw && !tile.classList.contains( 'aa-loot-left' ) ) { tile.classList.add( 'aa-loot-left' ); } else if ( c.left < 0 && tile.classList.contains( 'aa-loot-left' ) ) { tile.classList.remove( 'aa-loot-left' ); } } ); } // a link in the text (item, skill or buff, not on a loot table tile): same rule, using the middle of the page content function placeInline( tip, kind ) { var left = 'aa-' + kind + 'tip-left'; var area = tip.closest( '.mw-parser-output' ) || document.body; var box = area.getBoundingClientRect(); var r = tip.getBoundingClientRect(); var tipMid = ( r.left + r.right ) / 2; var boxMid = ( box.left + box.right ) / 2; tip.classList.toggle( left, tipMid > boxMid + 8 ); var card = tip.querySelector( '.aa-' + kind + 'tip-card' ); if ( !card ) { return; } window.requestAnimationFrame( function () { var c = card.getBoundingClientRect(); if ( !c.width ) { return; } var vw = document.documentElement.clientWidth; if ( c.right > vw && !tip.classList.contains( left ) ) { tip.classList.add( left ); } else if ( c.left < 0 && tip.classList.contains( left ) ) { tip.classList.remove( left ); } } ); } function handler( e ) { var el = e.target; if ( el.nodeType !== 1 ) { el = el.parentNode; } if ( !el || !el.closest ) { return; } var tile = el.closest( '.aa-loot-item' ); if ( tile ) { place( tile ); pages[ 0 ] : pages[ Object.keys( pages )[ 0 ] ]; dataCache[ name ] = ( page && page.params ) ? page : { params: null }; return dataCache[ name ]; }, function () { return { params: null }; } ); } function text( v ) { // TemplateData texts can be a plain string or { language: string } if ( v && typeof v === 'object' ) { v = v.en || v[ Object.keys( v )[ 0 ] ]; } return v || ''; } function buildWikitext( name, params, values ) { var out = '{{' + name; var pos = 1; var positional = true; params.forEach( function ( p ) { var v = ( values[ p ] || '' ).replace( /^\s+|\s+$/g, '' ); if ( v === '' ) { if ( /^\d+$/.test( p ) ) { positional = false; } // a gap: later numbered ones need their number return; } if ( /^\d+$/.test( p ) && positional && Number( p ) === pos && v.indexOf( '=' ) === -1 ) { out += '|' + v; pos++; } else { out += '|' + p + '=' + v; if ( /^\d+$/.test( p ) ) { positional = false; } } } ); return out + '}}'; } function open( insert ) { mw.loader.using( [ 'oojs-ui-core', 'oojs-ui-windows', 'oojs-ui-widgets', 'oojs-ui.styles.icons-editing-advanced', 'mediawiki.api' ] ).then( function () { function Dialog( cfg ) { Dialog.super.call( this, cfg ); } OO.inheritClass( Dialog, OO.ui.ProcessDialog ); Dialog.static.name = 'aaTemplatePicker'; Dialog.static.title = 'Insert a template'; Dialog.static.size = 'large'; Dialog.prototype.initialize = function () { Dialog.super.prototype.initialize.apply( this, arguments ); var self = this; this.search = new OO.ui.SearchInputWidget( { placeholder: 'Search templates' } ); this.list = $( '

var ok = !!c; if ( c ) { c.order.forEach( function ( k ) { if ( c.params[ k ] && c.params[ k ].required && !c.fields[ k ].getValue().trim() ) { ok = false; } } ); } this.actions.setAbilities( { insert: ok } ); insert( buildWikitext( c.name, c.order, vals ) ); return self.close(); } ); } return Dialog.super.prototype.getActionProcess.call( this, act ); }; Dialog.prototype.getSetupProcess = function ( data ) { return Dialog.super.prototype.getSetupProcess.call( this, data ).next( function () { this.current = null; this.stack.setItem( this.pick ); this.actions.setMode( 'pick' ); this.search.setValue( '' ); this.fill(); loadTemplates().then( this.fill.bind( this ) ); }, this ); }; Dialog.prototype.getBodyHeight = function () { return 520; }; // the dialog shows Insert and Back only on the form step Dialog.static.actions = [ { action: 'insert', label: 'Insert', flags: [ 'primary', 'progressive' ], modes: 'form', disabled: true }, { action: 'back', label: 'Back', flags: 'safe', modes: 'form' }, { label: 'Cancel', flags: 'safe', modes: [ 'pick', 'form' ] } ]; var wm = new OO.ui.WindowManager(); $( document.body ).append( wm.$element ); var dlg = new Dialog(); wm.addWindows( [ dlg ] ); wm.openWindow( dlg ); } ); } function insertAtCursor( code ) { $( '#wpTextbox1' ).textSelection( 'encapsulateSelection', { pre: code, peri: '', post: '', replace: true } ); } window.aaTemplatePicker = { open: function () { open( insertAtCursor ); } }; mw.loader.using( 'ext.wikiEditor' ).then( function () { $( function () { var $t = $( '#wpTextbox1' ); if ( !$t.length ) { return; } $t.wikiEditor( 'addToToolbar', { section: 'advanced', group: 'insert', tools: { aaTemplate: { label: 'Insert template', type: 'button', oouiIcon: 'puzzle', action: { type: 'callback', execute: function () { window.aaTemplatePicker.open(); } } } } } ); } ); } ); }() ); /* Local times: {{LocalTime|20:00|tz=UTC+1|day=Saturday}} is shown in the reader's own time zone */ ( function () { var DAYS = [ 'sunday', 'monday', 'tuesday', 'wednesday', 'thursday', 'friday', 'saturday' ]; // "UTC", "UTC+1", "UTC-5", "UTC+5:30" -> minutes from UTC, or null if it cannot be read function offsetMinutes( tz ) { var m = /^\s*(?:UTC|GMT)\s*(?:([+\-−])\s*(\d{1,2})(?::?(\d{2}))?)?\s*$/i.exec( tz || 'UTC' ); if ( !m ) { return null; } if ( !m[ 1 ] ) { return 0; } var sign = m[ 1 ] === '+' ? 1 : -1; return sign * ( Number( m[ 2 ] ) * 60 + Number( m[ 3 ] || 0 ) ); } function parseTime( s ) { var m = /^\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*$/.exec( s || '' ); if ( !m || Number( m[ 1 ] ) > 23 || Number( m[ 2 ] ) > 59 ) { return null; } return Number( m[ 1 ] ) * 60 + Number( m[ 2 ] ); } // the next moment (a Date) at which the clock in the given zone shows hh:mm on that weekday (or any day) function nextMoment( minutes, offset, dayIndex, now ) { for ( var d = 0; d < 9; d++ ) { var base = new Date( now.getTime() + d * 86400000 ); var t = Date.UTC( base.getUTCFullYear(), base.getUTCMonth(), base.getUTCDate() ) + ( minutes - offset ) * 60000; // weekday of that moment in the zone it was written in var wd = new Date( t + offset * 60000 ).getUTCDay(); if ( t >= now.getTime() - 3600000 && ( dayIndex === null || wd === dayIndex ) ) { return new Date( t ); } } return null; } function convert( spec, now, locale ) { var from = parseTime( spec.time ); var off = offsetMinutes( spec.tz ); if ( from === null || off === null ) { return null; } var day = spec.day ? DAYS.indexOf( spec.day.toLowerCase() ) : -1; if ( spec.day && day === -1 ) { return null; } var start = nextMoment( from, off, day === -1 ? null : day, now ); if ( !start ) { return null; } var tf = new Intl.DateTimeFormat( locale, { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' } ); var out = tf.format( start ); if ( spec.to ) { var to = parseTime( spec.to ); if ( to !== null ) { var len = ( to - from + 1440 ) % 1440; out += '–' + tf.format( new Date( start.getTime() + len * 60000 ) ); } } if ( spec.day ) { out = new Intl.DateTimeFormat( locale, { weekday: 'long' } ).format( start ) + ' ' + out; } var zone = ''; try { var parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat( locale, { timeZoneName: 'short' } ).formatToParts( start ); parts.forEach( function ( p ) { if ( p.type === 'timeZoneName' ) { zone = p.value; } } ); } catch ( e ) { /* the zone name is only a bonus */ } return zone ? out + ' ' + zone : out; } function run( $root ) { $root.find( '.aa-localtime' ).each( function () { var el = this; if ( el.getAttribute( 'data-done' ) ) { return; } var text = convert( { time: el.getAttribute( 'data-time' ), to: el.getAttribute( 'data-to' ), tz: el.getAttribute( 'data-tz' ), day: el.getAttribute( 'data-day' ) }, new Date(), undefined ); if ( text ) { el.textContent = text; el.setAttribute( 'data-done', '1' ); } } ); } mw.hook( 'wikipage.content' ).add( run ); window.aaLocalTime = { convert: convert }; }() );

<pre><code>/* Any JavaScript here will be loaded for all users on every page load. */




/* Skill cards ({{Skill|ID}}) and skill trees ({{Skilltree|...}}): clicking a version name (Basic, Flame ...), a chain icon
   or the rank item button (Fantasia of Sorcery) shows that card.
   Without this script the same switching is done by CSS (:target), but then only one card per page can be switched
   independently, the address of the page changes, and in a skill tree the open card closes when the pointer leaves it.
   With it, every card on the page keeps its own choice, the address does not change, the page does not scroll, the icon
   of a skill tree tile follows the card that is shown, and a skill tree card that was clicked open stays open.
   Paste at the end of MediaWiki:Common.js */
mw.hook( 'wikipage.content' ).add( function ( $content ) {
	$content.find( '.aa-skill-set' ).each( function () {
		var set = this;
		if ( set.getAttribute( 'data-aa-skill-js' ) ) { return; }
		set.setAttribute( 'data-aa-skill-js', '1' );
		var tile = set.closest ? set.closest( '.aa-tree-tile' ) : null;

		function isSwitch( e ) {
			var link = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest( 'a[href*="#aa-skill"]' ) : null;
			return link && /v(\d+)k(\d+)$/.test( link.getAttribute( 'href' ) ) ? link : null;
		}

		// a click on a link would move the focus from the tile to the link, and the open card would close
		set.addEventListener( 'mousedown', function ( e ) {
			if ( tile && isSwitch( e ) ) { e.preventDefault(); }
		} );

		set.addEventListener( 'click', function ( e ) {
			var link = isSwitch( e );
			if ( !link ) { return; }
			var m = /v(\d+)k(\d+)$/.exec( link.getAttribute( 'href' ) );
			var box = set.querySelector( ':scope > .aa-varset-v' + m[1] );
			if ( !box ) { return; }
			e.preventDefault();
			Array.prototype.forEach.call( set.querySelectorAll( ':scope > .aa-varset' ), function ( o ) {
				o.style.display = ( o === box ) ? 'grid' : 'none';
			} );
			Array.prototype.forEach.call( box.children, function ( card ) {
				card.style.visibility = card.classList.contains( 'aa-card-k' + m[2] ) ? 'visible' : 'hidden';
			} );
			// the icon of a skill tree tile
			var icons = set.querySelector( ':scope > .aa-tileicons' );
			if ( icons ) {
				Array.prototype.forEach.call( icons.children, function ( ic ) {
					ic.style.display = ( ic.classList.contains( 'aa-ti-v' + m[1] ) && ic.classList.contains( 'aa-ti-k' + m[2] ) ) ? 'block' : 'none';
				} );
			}
			if ( tile ) { tile.focus( { preventScroll: true } ); }
		} );
	} );
} );





/* Lazy skill cards. A skill link made by {{SkillLink|id|tree=...}}, {{TreeSkills}} or {{TreeCombo}} carries only its icon and name
   (class aa-lazy, data-sid, data-tree). The card is asked from the wiki (action=parse, {{#invoke:Skilltree|card|id|Tree}}) when the
   pointer first rests on the link, and the other links of the same group are fetched quietly after it, so the next hover is instant.
   An answer is cached in the browser and by the wiki for a day. The skill switching block (versions, chains) keeps working in the
   cards that arrive, because they are announced with mw.hook( 'wikipage.content' ).
   Paste at the end of MediaWiki:Common.js, after the block "Skill cards ... skill trees". */
( function () {
	var cache = {};    // 'id|Tree' -> promise of the html of the card ('' when it failed)
	var queue = [];
	var running = 0;
	var counter = 0;

	function key( span ) {
		return span.getAttribute( 'data-sid' ) + '|' + span.getAttribute( 'data-tree' );
	}

	function fetchCard( k ) {
		if ( cache[ k ] ) { return cache[ k ]; }
		var p = k.split( '|' );
		cache[ k ] = mw.loader.using( 'mediawiki.api' ).then( function () {
			return new mw.Api().get( {
				action: 'parse',
				format: 'json',
				formatversion: 2,
				contentmodel: 'wikitext',
				title: mw.config.get( 'wgPageName' ),
				text: '{{#invoke:Skilltree|card|' + p[ 0 ] + '|' + p[ 1 ] + '}}',
				prop: 'text',
				disablelimitreport: 1,
				disableeditsection: 1,
				disabletoc: 1,
				wrapoutputclass: '',
				maxage: 86400,
				smaxage: 86400
			} );
		} ).then( function ( r ) {
			var tmp = document.createElement( 'div' );
			tmp.innerHTML = r.parse.text;
			var card = tmp.querySelector( '.aa-lazy-card' );
			if ( !card ) { throw new Error( 'no card' ); }
			return card.innerHTML;
		} ).catch( function () {
			delete cache[ k ];    // try again at the next hover
			return '';
		} );
		return cache[ k ];
	}

	// the anchors of a card made on the server are the same for every card of that skill: give each card on the page its own
	function uniquify( root ) {
		var n = ++counter;
		function fix( s ) { return s.replace( /-(v\d+k\d+)$/, '-x' + n + '-$1' ); }
		Array.prototype.forEach.call( root.querySelectorAll( '[id^="aa-skill"]' ), function ( el ) {
			el.id = fix( el.id );
		} );
		Array.prototype.forEach.call( root.querySelectorAll( 'a[href^="#aa-skill"]' ), function ( a ) {
			a.setAttribute( 'href', fix( a.getAttribute( 'href' ) ) );
		} );
	}

	function fill( span ) {
		var state = span.getAttribute( 'data-aa-lazy' );
		if ( state === 'loading' || state === 'done' ) { return; }
		span.setAttribute( 'data-aa-lazy', 'loading' );
		fetchCard( key( span ) ).then( function ( html ) {
			var holder = span.querySelector( ':scope > .aa-skilltip-card' );
			if ( !html || !holder ) {
				span.removeAttribute( 'data-aa-lazy' );
				return;
			}
			holder.innerHTML = html;
			uniquify( holder );
			span.setAttribute( 'data-aa-lazy', 'done' );
			mw.hook( 'wikipage.content' ).fire( $( holder ) );
		} );
		prefetchGroup( span );
	}

	// the links of the same list or card are fetched after the one that is hovered (two at a time)
	function prefetchGroup( span ) {
		var group = span.closest( '.aa-ts, .aa-tc' );
		if ( !group ) { return; }
		Array.prototype.forEach.call( group.querySelectorAll( '.aa-lazy' ), function ( s ) {
			var k = key( s );
			if ( !cache[ k ] && queue.indexOf( k ) === -1 ) { queue.push( k ); }
		} );
		pump();
	}

	function pump() {
		while ( running < 2 && queue.length ) {
			var k = queue.shift();
			if ( cache[ k ] ) { continue; }
			running++;
			fetchCard( k ).then( function () { running--; pump(); } );
		}
	}

	function onEnter( e ) {
		var span = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest( '.aa-lazy' ) : null;
		if ( span ) { fill( span ); }
	}
	document.addEventListener( 'mouseover', onEnter );
	document.addEventListener( 'focusin', onEnter );
	document.addEventListener( 'touchstart', onEnter, { passive: true } );
}() );





/* Edit page quick jump buttons (preview <-> editor), shown at the bottom of the Contents menu */
mw.loader.using('mediawiki.util').then(function () {
	var action = mw.config.get('wgAction');
	if (action !== 'edit' && action !== 'submit') { return; }
	$(function () {
		if (!document.getElementById('wpTextbox1')) { return; } /* source editor only */

		mw.util.addCSS(
			'.aa-jump{position:fixed;right:20px;bottom:20px;z-index:150;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}' +
			'.aa-jump.aa-jump-toc{position:static;flex-direction:row;padding:12px 16px 14px;border-top:1px solid var(--border-color-base,#555)}' +
			'.aa-jump.aa-jump-toc button{flex:1}' +
			'.aa-jump button{cursor:pointer;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:8px;font:600 14px/1 inherit;' +
			'color:var(--color-emphasized,#fff);background:var(--color-surface-2,#333);' +
			'border:1px solid var(--border-color-base,#555);box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}' +
			'.aa-jump button:hover{background:var(--color-surface-3,#444)}' +
			'#wikiPreview,#wikiEditor-ui-toolbar,#wpTextbox1{scroll-margin-top:72px}'
		);

		var box = $('<div class="aa-jump"></div>');
		var up = $('<button type="button">\u2191 Preview</button>').on('click', function () {
			var p = document.getElementById('wikiPreview');
			if (p) { p.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' }); }
		});
		var down = $('<button type="button">\u2193 Editor</button>').on('click', function () {
			var t = document.getElementById('wikiEditor-ui-toolbar') || document.getElementById('wpTextbox1');
			t.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
			document.getElementById('wpTextbox1').focus({ preventScroll: true });
		});
		box.append(up, down).appendTo(document.body);

		function sync() {
			var p = document.getElementById('wikiPreview');
			up.toggle(!!p && p.offsetHeight > 0 && $.trim($(p).text()) !== '');
			/* dock into the Contents card when it exists, otherwise float in the corner */
			var toc = document.getElementById('mw-panel-toc');
			if (toc) {
				if (box[0].parentNode !== toc) { box.addClass('aa-jump-toc').appendTo(toc); }
			} else if (box[0].parentNode !== document.body) {
				box.removeClass('aa-jump-toc').appendTo(document.body);
			}
		}
		sync();
		setInterval(sync, 1000); /* also covers live preview and a rebuilt Contents menu */
	});
});








/* Item, skill and buff hover cards: the hover card opens towards the middle of the loot table (so right of the tiles on the left half, left of the tiles on the right half).
   If the card would run out of the window on that side, it opens on the other side. On a phone the CSS opens it downwards. */
( function () {
	function place( tile ) {
		var area = tile.closest( '.aa-loot' ) || tile.parentNode;
		var box = area.getBoundingClientRect();
		var r = tile.getBoundingClientRect();
		var tileMid = ( r.left + r.right ) / 2;
		var boxMid = ( box.left + box.right ) / 2;
		tile.classList.toggle( 'aa-loot-left', tileMid > boxMid + 8 );

		// then check that the card is inside the window, and use the other side if it is not
		var card = tile.querySelector( '.aa-itemtip-card' );
		if ( !card ) { return; }
		window.requestAnimationFrame( function () {
			var c = card.getBoundingClientRect();
			if ( !c.width ) { return; }
			var vw = document.documentElement.clientWidth;
			if ( c.right > vw && !tile.classList.contains( 'aa-loot-left' ) ) {
				tile.classList.add( 'aa-loot-left' );
			} else if ( c.left < 0 && tile.classList.contains( 'aa-loot-left' ) ) {
				tile.classList.remove( 'aa-loot-left' );
			}
		} );
	}
	// a link in the text (item, skill or buff, not on a loot table tile): same rule, using the middle of the page content
	function placeInline( tip, kind ) {
		var left = 'aa-' + kind + 'tip-left';
		var area = tip.closest( '.mw-parser-output' ) || document.body;
		var box = area.getBoundingClientRect();
		var r = tip.getBoundingClientRect();
		var tipMid = ( r.left + r.right ) / 2;
		var boxMid = ( box.left + box.right ) / 2;
		tip.classList.toggle( left, tipMid > boxMid + 8 );
		var card = tip.querySelector( '.aa-' + kind + 'tip-card' );
		if ( !card ) { return; }
		window.requestAnimationFrame( function () {
			var c = card.getBoundingClientRect();
			if ( !c.width ) { return; }
			var vw = document.documentElement.clientWidth;
			if ( c.right > vw && !tip.classList.contains( left ) ) {
				tip.classList.add( left );
			} else if ( c.left < 0 && tip.classList.contains( left ) ) {
				tip.classList.remove( left );
			}
		} );
	}
	function handler( e ) {
		var el = e.target;
		if ( el.nodeType !== 1 ) { el = el.parentNode; }
		if ( !el || !el.closest ) { return; }
		var tile = el.closest( '.aa-loot-item' );
		if ( tile ) { place( tile ); return; }
		var kinds = [ 'item', 'skill', 'buff' ];
		for ( var i = 0; i < kinds.length; i++ ) {
			var tip = el.closest( '.aa-' + kinds[ i ] + 'tip' );
			if ( tip ) { placeInline( tip, kinds[ i ] ); return; }
		}
	}
	document.addEventListener( 'mouseover', handler );
	document.addEventListener( 'focusin', handler );
}() );







/* Source editor: an "Insert template" button that works like the template helper of VisualEditor.
   Pick a template from a searchable list, fill in its parameters (labels, descriptions and required marks come from its TemplateData) and insert it at the cursor. */
( function () {
	var action = mw.config.get( 'wgAction' );
	if ( action !== 'edit' && action !== 'submit' ) { return; }

	var templates = null;      // names of all templates, loaded once
	var dataCache = {};

	function loadTemplates() {
		if ( templates ) { return $.Deferred().resolve( templates ).promise(); }
		var all = [];
		var api = new mw.Api();
		function step( cont ) {
			var q = { action: 'query', list: 'allpages', apnamespace: 10, apfilterredir: 'nonredirects', aplimit: 'max', formatversion: 2 };
			if ( cont ) { $.extend( q, cont ); }
			return api.get( q ).then( function ( r ) {
				r.query.allpages.forEach( function ( p ) { all.push( p.title.replace( /^[^:]+:/, '' ) ); } );
				if ( r.continue ) { return step( r.continue ); }
				templates = all.filter( function ( n ) { return !/\/(doc|styles\.css|sandbox|testcases)$/i.test( n ); } );
				return templates;
			} );
		}
		return step( null );
	}

	function loadData( name ) {
		if ( dataCache[ name ] ) { return $.Deferred().resolve( dataCache[ name ] ).promise(); }
		return new mw.Api().get( { action: 'templatedata', titles: 'Template:' + name, redirects: 1, lang: mw.config.get( 'wgUserLanguage' ), formatversion: 2 } ).then( function ( r ) {
			var pages = r.pages || [];
			var page = Array.isArray( pages ) ? pages[ 0 ] : pages[ Object.keys( pages )[ 0 ] ];
			dataCache[ name ] = ( page && page.params ) ? page : { params: null };
			return dataCache[ name ];
		}, function () { return { params: null }; } );
	}

	function text( v ) {            // TemplateData texts can be a plain string or { language: string }
		if ( v && typeof v === 'object' ) { v = v.en || v[ Object.keys( v )[ 0 ] ]; }
		return v || '';
	}

	function buildWikitext( name, params, values ) {
		var out = '{{' + name;
		var pos = 1;
		var positional = true;
		params.forEach( function ( p ) {
			var v = ( values[ p ] || '' ).replace( /^\s+|\s+$/g, '' );
			if ( v === '' ) {
				if ( /^\d+$/.test( p ) ) { positional = false; }   // a gap: later numbered ones need their number
				return;
			}
			if ( /^\d+$/.test( p ) && positional && Number( p ) === pos && v.indexOf( '=' ) === -1 ) {
				out += '|' + v;
				pos++;
			} else {
				out += '|' + p + '=' + v;
				if ( /^\d+$/.test( p ) ) { positional = false; }
			}
		} );
		return out + '}}';
	}

	function open( insert ) {
		mw.loader.using( [ 'oojs-ui-core', 'oojs-ui-windows', 'oojs-ui-widgets', 'oojs-ui.styles.icons-editing-advanced', 'mediawiki.api' ] ).then( function () {
			function Dialog( cfg ) { Dialog.super.call( this, cfg ); }
			OO.inheritClass( Dialog, OO.ui.ProcessDialog );
			Dialog.static.name = 'aaTemplatePicker';
			Dialog.static.title = 'Insert a template';
			Dialog.static.size = 'large';
			Dialog.prototype.initialize = function () {
				Dialog.super.prototype.initialize.apply( this, arguments );
				var self = this;
				this.search = new OO.ui.SearchInputWidget( { placeholder: 'Search templates' } );
				this.list = $( '<div>' ).css( { 'max-height': '50vh', 'overflow-y': 'auto', 'margin-top': '10px' } );
				this.pick = new OO.ui.PanelLayout( { padded: true, expanded: false } );
				this.pick.$element.append( this.search.$element, this.list );
				this.formPanel = new OO.ui.PanelLayout( { padded: true, expanded: false } );
				this.stack = new OO.ui.StackLayout( { items: [ this.pick, this.formPanel ], continuous: false } );
				this.$body.append( this.stack.$element );
				this.search.on( 'change', function () { self.fill(); } );
				this.current = null;
			};
			Dialog.prototype.fill = function () {
				var self = this;
				var q = this.search.getValue().toLowerCase().replace( /_/g, ' ' );
				this.list.empty();
				if ( !templates ) { this.list.text( 'Loading ...' ); return; }
				var shown = 0;
				templates.forEach( function ( n ) {
					if ( shown >= 60 || ( q && n.toLowerCase().indexOf( q ) === -1 ) ) { return; }
					shown++;
					$( '<div>' ).text( n ).css( { padding: '5px 8px', cursor: 'pointer', 'border-radius': '4px' } )
						.on( 'mouseenter', function () { $( this ).css( 'background', 'rgba(128,128,128,.25)' ); } )
						.on( 'mouseleave', function () { $( this ).css( 'background', '' ); } )
						.on( 'click', function () { self.choose( n ); } )
						.appendTo( self.list );
				} );
				if ( !shown ) { this.list.text( 'No template found.' ); }
			};
			Dialog.prototype.choose = function ( name ) {
				var self = this;
				loadData( name ).then( function ( data ) {
					self.current = { name: name, order: [], fields: {} };
					self.formPanel.$element.empty();
					var head = $( '<div>' ).css( { 'font-weight': 'bold', 'font-size': '1.15em', 'margin-bottom': '4px' } ).text( name );
					self.formPanel.$element.append( head );
					var desc = text( data.description );
					if ( desc ) { self.formPanel.$element.append( $( '<div>' ).css( 'margin-bottom', '10px' ).text( desc ) ); }
					var params = data.params;
					if ( params ) {
						var order = ( data.paramOrder && data.paramOrder.length ) ? data.paramOrder : Object.keys( params );
						Object.keys( params ).forEach( function ( k ) { if ( order.indexOf( k ) === -1 ) { order.push( k ); } } );
						order.forEach( function ( k ) {
							var p = params[ k ];
							if ( !p || p.deprecated ) { return; }
							var multi = p.type === 'content' || p.type === 'unbalanced-wikitext';
							var w = new OO.ui.TextInputWidget( { multiline: multi, rows: 2, autosize: multi, placeholder: text( p.example ) || ( p.default ? String( p.default ) : '' ) } );
							w.on( 'change', function () { self.refresh(); } );
							self.current.order.push( k );
							self.current.fields[ k ] = w;
							var label = ( text( p.label ) || k ) + ( p.required ? ' *' : '' );
							var layout = new OO.ui.FieldLayout( w, { label: label, align: 'top', help: text( p.description ) || undefined, helpInline: true } );
							self.formPanel.$element.append( layout.$element );
						} );
					} else {
						self.formPanel.$element.append( $( '<div>' ).css( 'margin', '8px 0' ).text( 'This template has no TemplateData. It is inserted without parameters.' ) );
					}
					self.current.params = params || {};
					self.stack.setItem( self.formPanel );
					self.actions.setMode( 'form' );
					self.refresh();
					self.updateSize();
				} );
			};
			Dialog.prototype.refresh = function () {
				var c = this.current;
				var ok = !!c;
				if ( c ) {
					c.order.forEach( function ( k ) {
						if ( c.params[ k ] && c.params[ k ].required && !c.fields[ k ].getValue().trim() ) { ok = false; }
					} );
				}
				this.actions.setAbilities( { insert: ok } );
			};
			Dialog.prototype.getActionProcess = function ( act ) {
				var self = this;
				if ( act === 'back' ) {
					return new OO.ui.Process( function () {
						self.current = null;
						self.stack.setItem( self.pick );
						self.actions.setMode( 'pick' );
						self.updateSize();
					} );
				}
				if ( act === 'insert' ) {
					return new OO.ui.Process( function () {
						var c = self.current, vals = {};
						c.order.forEach( function ( k ) { vals[ k ] = c.fields[ k ].getValue(); } );
						insert( buildWikitext( c.name, c.order, vals ) );
						return self.close();
					} );
				}
				return Dialog.super.prototype.getActionProcess.call( this, act );
			};
			Dialog.prototype.getSetupProcess = function ( data ) {
				return Dialog.super.prototype.getSetupProcess.call( this, data ).next( function () {
					this.current = null;
					this.stack.setItem( this.pick );
					this.actions.setMode( 'pick' );
					this.search.setValue( '' );
					this.fill();
					loadTemplates().then( this.fill.bind( this ) );
				}, this );
			};
			Dialog.prototype.getBodyHeight = function () { return 520; };

			// the dialog shows Insert and Back only on the form step
			Dialog.static.actions = [
				{ action: 'insert', label: 'Insert', flags: [ 'primary', 'progressive' ], modes: 'form', disabled: true },
				{ action: 'back', label: 'Back', flags: 'safe', modes: 'form' },
				{ label: 'Cancel', flags: 'safe', modes: [ 'pick', 'form' ] }
			];

			var wm = new OO.ui.WindowManager();
			$( document.body ).append( wm.$element );
			var dlg = new Dialog();
			wm.addWindows( [ dlg ] );
			wm.openWindow( dlg );
		} );
	}

	function insertAtCursor( code ) {
		$( '#wpTextbox1' ).textSelection( 'encapsulateSelection', { pre: code, peri: '', post: '', replace: true } );
	}

	window.aaTemplatePicker = { open: function () { open( insertAtCursor ); } };

	mw.loader.using( 'ext.wikiEditor' ).then( function () {
		$( function () {
			var $t = $( '#wpTextbox1' );
			if ( !$t.length ) { return; }
			$t.wikiEditor( 'addToToolbar', {
				section: 'advanced',
				group: 'insert',
				tools: {
					aaTemplate: {
						label: 'Insert template',
						type: 'button',
						oouiIcon: 'puzzle',
						action: { type: 'callback', execute: function () { window.aaTemplatePicker.open(); } }
					}
				}
			} );
		} );
	} );
}() );






/* Local times: {{LocalTime|20:00|tz=UTC+1|day=Saturday}} is shown in the reader's own time zone */
( function () {
	var DAYS = [ 'sunday', 'monday', 'tuesday', 'wednesday', 'thursday', 'friday', 'saturday' ];

	// "UTC", "UTC+1", "UTC-5", "UTC+5:30" -> minutes from UTC, or null if it cannot be read
	function offsetMinutes( tz ) {
		var m = /^\s*(?:UTC|GMT)\s*(?:([+\-−])\s*(\d{1,2})(?::?(\d{2}))?)?\s*$/i.exec( tz || 'UTC' );
		if ( !m ) { return null; }
		if ( !m[ 1 ] ) { return 0; }
		var sign = m[ 1 ] === '+' ? 1 : -1;
		return sign * ( Number( m[ 2 ] ) * 60 + Number( m[ 3 ] || 0 ) );
	}

	function parseTime( s ) {
		var m = /^\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*$/.exec( s || '' );
		if ( !m || Number( m[ 1 ] ) > 23 || Number( m[ 2 ] ) > 59 ) { return null; }
		return Number( m[ 1 ] ) * 60 + Number( m[ 2 ] );
	}

	// the next moment (a Date) at which the clock in the given zone shows hh:mm on that weekday (or any day)
	function nextMoment( minutes, offset, dayIndex, now ) {
		for ( var d = 0; d < 9; d++ ) {
			var base = new Date( now.getTime() + d * 86400000 );
			var t = Date.UTC( base.getUTCFullYear(), base.getUTCMonth(), base.getUTCDate() ) + ( minutes - offset ) * 60000;
			// weekday of that moment in the zone it was written in
			var wd = new Date( t + offset * 60000 ).getUTCDay();
			if ( t >= now.getTime() - 3600000 && ( dayIndex === null || wd === dayIndex ) ) { return new Date( t ); }
		}
		return null;
	}

	function convert( spec, now, locale ) {
		var from = parseTime( spec.time );
		var off = offsetMinutes( spec.tz );
		if ( from === null || off === null ) { return null; }
		var day = spec.day ? DAYS.indexOf( spec.day.toLowerCase() ) : -1;
		if ( spec.day && day === -1 ) { return null; }
		var start = nextMoment( from, off, day === -1 ? null : day, now );
		if ( !start ) { return null; }
		var tf = new Intl.DateTimeFormat( locale, { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' } );
		var out = tf.format( start );
		if ( spec.to ) {
			var to = parseTime( spec.to );
			if ( to !== null ) {
				var len = ( to - from + 1440 ) % 1440;
				out += '–' + tf.format( new Date( start.getTime() + len * 60000 ) );
			}
		}
		if ( spec.day ) {
			out = new Intl.DateTimeFormat( locale, { weekday: 'long' } ).format( start ) + ' ' + out;
		}
		var zone = '';
		try {
			var parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat( locale, { timeZoneName: 'short' } ).formatToParts( start );
			parts.forEach( function ( p ) { if ( p.type === 'timeZoneName' ) { zone = p.value; } } );
		} catch ( e ) { /* the zone name is only a bonus */ }
		return zone ? out + ' ' + zone : out;
	}

	function run( $root ) {
		$root.find( '.aa-localtime' ).each( function () {
			var el = this;
			if ( el.getAttribute( 'data-done' ) ) { return; }
			var text = convert( {
				time: el.getAttribute( 'data-time' ),
				to: el.getAttribute( 'data-to' ),
				tz: el.getAttribute( 'data-tz' ),
				day: el.getAttribute( 'data-day' )
			}, new Date(), undefined );
			if ( text ) {
				el.textContent = text;
				el.setAttribute( 'data-done', '1' );
			}
		} );
	}

	mw.hook( 'wikipage.content' ).add( run );
	window.aaLocalTime = { convert: convert };
}() );</code></pre>
